C. Investigate and respond to threats
Practice incident investigation and response
(this article)
At any time during your pilot and deployment, you can test Microsoft Defender XDR's
incident response and automated investigation and remediation capabilities by creating
an incident with a simulated attack and using the Microsoft Defender portal to
investigate and respond.
Here's the workflow for investigating and responding to incidents using Microsoft
